props.name: end
props.description: When the window is expected to close.

props.name: title
props.description: What is being worked on — "Database upgrade".

props.name: description
props.description: Extra detail: what to expect, what to do beforehand.

props.name: impact
props.description: How much readers will notice. Drives the impact line.

props.name: statusHref
props.description: A status page with live updates.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Remember a dismissal in this browser. The window's start time is added to the key, so dismissing this window never hides the next one. Reads and writes are guarded.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the notice is dismissed. Leave both this and storageKey out to make it permanent.

props.name: completedFor
props.description: Milliseconds to keep saying "completed" after the window ends, before the notice goes.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time. Leave it out to follow the clock; pass it to pin a phase in a test or a demo.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone for the window. Defaults to the reader’s own.
